title: CWP/14166/2025 of RUPINDER KAUR AND ANOTHER Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 118 Date of decision: 16.05.2025 Rupinder Kaur and Another ....Petitioners Versus State of Punjab and Others ...Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMAN CHAUDHARY Present : Ms. Vanshika Grover, Advocate for the petitioners Mr. Satnam Preet Singh, DAG Punjab AMAN CHAUDHARY, J. (ORAL)

1. The prayer made in the present petition is for directing the respondents to give appointment to the petitioners as they are duly eligible and fulfils the required eligibility conditions and were duly selected for the 2364 posts of Elementary Teacher.

2. Learned counsel submits that regarding the claim as raised in the present petition, a legal notice dated 19.02.2025, Annexure P-8, has been served upon respondents, however, the same has yet not evoked any response. He thus, on instructions prays that a direction may be given to the respondents to decide the same in a time bound manner, to which learned State counsel has no objection to the limited prayer made.

3. In view of the above and without commenting on the merits of the case, this petition is hereby disposed of with a direction to the respondents to decide the legal notice dated 19.02.2025, in accordance with law, expeditiously. (AMAN CHAUDHARY) JUDGE 16.05.2025 M.Kamra
